item: Help body x12: measured tranche plan and the translated-documents test
summary: Measured the ten served Help documents in characters (750,229; 8,252,519 owed across 11 locales) and proposed three tranches (20, 55, 33 document-locale pairs) in the 0.6 gate section 3. tests/test_help_docs_translated.py counts each pair COMPLETE (same heading skeleton, fenced headings ignored), PARTIAL (listed exactly) or ABSENT, with a per-tranche floor that may only rise, a truthful X-OO-Doc-Lang and translated flag for every slug x locale, and a mutation check. Today 0 of 110 pairs are complete: docs/i18n/fr/QUICKSTART.md is an 8-heading abridgement of 17 and is listed PARTIAL. No local model is reachable in the build container, so drafting is an operator step; nothing was hand-translated. Stated limit: a PARTIAL draft is still served as its language, so the banner (E2) cannot yet tell abridged from complete.
